notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33033542/bae164b4664cc688d24aca027d5a60596431fe6f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Zombie Head updated![/h1]
[list]
     [*]Corrected the difficulty balance at all levels.
     [*]The design of some levels has been changed.
     [*]Steam Cloud support added.
     [*]Improved game performance.
     [*]Most visual effects are optimized.
     [*]Fixed many minor bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.9
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33033542/8523b4e3111e5e5d5ab55557253519411c82e96b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Zombie Head updated![/h1]
[list]
     [*]Added tutorial.
     [*]Added platform rotation from the keyboard.
     [*]Added sensitivity settings for mouse and keyboard.
     [*]Fixed a bug where the head received double damage when hit by spikes.
     [*]Fixed a bug with the head being caught between spikes and other objects.
     [*]Added key tooltips to skills in the game interface.
     [*]Decreased default sound volume.
     [*]Improved game performance.
     [*]Changed the design of some levels.
     [*]Improved interface elements.
     [*]Fixed minor bugs.
[/list]
